content.value_statement: Finding milestone status across Linear projects can require repeated navigation. This skill lists milestones from the terminal with project filters, limits, and optional JSON output.
actual_capabilities: Lists milestones for a Linear project using a partial, case-insensitive project name.
Lists milestones across all accessible Linear projects.
Limits the maximum number of returned milestones.
Displays terminal table output without changing Linear data.
Provides JSON output for downstream filtering tools.
limitations: Requires Bun and a valid LINEAR_API_KEY.
Only reads milestones; it does not create, update, or delete Linear records.
Project access is limited to permissions granted to the supplied Linear API key.
The reviewed files document the command but do not include its executable implementation.

use_cases.description: List milestones for a named project before planning work or reporting progress.

use_cases.title: Scan portfolio milestones
use_cases.description: List a limited set of milestones across all accessible projects for coordination.

use_cases.description: Request JSON output for filtering, comparison, or reporting workflows.

prompt_templates.title: List one project
prompt_templates.prompt: List milestones for the Linear project named {project_name}.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a focused milestone lookup.

prompt_templates.title: Limit an organization-wide list
prompt_templates.prompt: List milestones across all accessible Linear projects. Return at most {limit} results.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review a manageable cross-project milestone set.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare data for filtering
prompt_templates.prompt: List milestones for {project_name} in JSON format so I can filter the results by {criterion}.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use structured output in a downstream workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Compare milestone details
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve up to {limit} milestones across all projects in JSON format. Then analyze {fields} for {comparison_goal}.
prompt_templates.scenario: Combine broad retrieval with an explicit analysis request.

output_examples.input: List milestones for project Mount Vernon.
output: Milestones are displayed in the terminal table.

output_examples.input: List up to 10 milestones across all projects.
output: Milestones are displayed directly in the terminal.

output_examples.input: Return milestones for Monticello in JSON format.
output_examples.output: The command returns structured milestone data in JSON format for downstream processing.

best_practices: Use the narrowest project filter that matches the task.
Set a result limit when listing milestones across all projects.
Store LINEAR_API_KEY outside version control and restrict its Linear permissions.
anti_patterns: Do not request write operations because this skill is read-only.
Do not paste API keys into prompts, command arguments, or chat messages.
Do not request reformatted table output unless additional analysis is required.

faq.question: What does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires the Bun runtime and a valid LINEAR_API_KEY.

faq.question: Does this skill modify Linear data?
faq.answer: No. It only reads project milestones.

faq.question: Can it list milestones from every project?
faq.answer: Yes. The all-project option lists milestones across projects available to the API key.

faq.question: How are project names matched?
faq.answer: Project names support partial, case-insensitive matching.

faq.question: Can it return JSON output?
faq.answer: Yes. JSON output is available for filtering and other downstream processing.

faq.question: What is the default result limit?
faq.answer: The command returns up to 25 results by default.
